infobox.leads to: Stray Dogs, The Huntsman Path - Relentless

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Huntsman Path - Trophy is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Oh, it's you? I have something special for you today, a new hunt. There is this bastard, folks call him Reshala. You've definitely heard of him. He's got that golden pistol, one of a kind. This moron with the gang of his has been there for a while - robbing and killing people. He himself is just a coward, always hiding behind his guards. Help people get rid of him, the whole Tarkov will breathe easier. And take his pistol, It will be a good gift for Mechanic and his collection. But be extremely careful, many good fighters have already been killed by his gang. Good luck, hunter."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate Reshala
- Find 1 Reshala's Golden TT in raid
- Hand over 1 Reshala's Golden TT to Jaeger

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +15,300 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.02
- 90,000 Roubles
  - 94,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 103,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Magazine case
- 3× Golden neck chain
- 2× Gold skull ring
- 1× Roler Submariner gold wrist watch
"You've done a good deed. One less bastard walking on this land. Take this, a gift from me and Mechanic."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Tokarev TT-33 7.62x25 TT pistol (Golden) | 1 | Handover item | Yes | Can be found on Reshala. |
In this quest you have to kill Reshala and find his golden TT pistol in raid.
